messages:
carmen: opening an expedited hotfix for encoder routing - sporadic 502s on long batched inputs. built encoder:v1.9.7-surg. no schema changes. requesting lifeboat rollout in next 30m (10% -> 50% -> 100%). /cc @hari @oncall-zoe

hari: please paste deploy link, exact rollback steps, and confirm whether kv-cache shards are touched. also would like a short perf delta (p95/p99).

carmen: deploy: https://deploy.internal/redwood/deploys/1722229999. kv-cache untouched (checked with infra). smoke tests passed in staging. perf: p95 +0.6%, p99 +1.1%. rollback plan (manual + pin):

```
# rollback to previous image
kubectl -n prod set image deploy/encoder encoder=redwood/encoder:v1.9.6
# pin previous version in release-config to block auto-rolls
curl -X POST https://release-config.internal/pin -d '{"service":"encoder","version":"v1.9.6","reason":"rollback after hotfix"}'
```
I can run the pin if we need to rollback.

deploybot: deploy request received for encoder:v1.9.7-surg. CI: \u2705 unit, \u2705 integration, e2e flaky (non-blocking). proposed canary: 10% for 4m, auto-pause if error_rate > 0.9% for 2m. Reply "approve" or react :thumbsup:.

oncall-zoe: i'll be on pager for the next 60m and watching traces. ok with expedited path if we hold a 4m health gate and have rollback owner. enabling verbose encoder logs. +1

infra-ben: confirmed kv-cache not affected. recommend adding circuit-breaker config: error_threshold=0.9%, window=2m, and tail-latency alert at +12%. I'll add the metric.

hari: adding the circuit-breaker to rollout config now and drafting release note: "Hotfix: encoder routing fix for long batches (v1.9.7-surg)."

releasebot: draft RN-512 created (encoder v1.9.7-surg). will publish after successful rollout.

carmen: starting canary now. watch: https://grafana.company/d/encoder/health. canary link: https://deploy.internal/redwood/deploys/1722229999/canary

deploybot: Canary started at 1722230010 -> encoder:v1.9.7-surg @10% traffic. health gate 4m.

carmen: note: if we need an emergency rollback, use the kubectl command above and then pin to v1.9.6. I'll also open a short post-release note for the postmortem if anything crop up.

oncall-zoe: 2m into canary: error_rate 0.15%, p99 stable. continuing to watch.

infra-ben: 3.5m: error_rate 0.12%, tail-latency +0.8% — within thresholds. recommend ramp to 50% for 3m.

carmen: ramping to 50% now.

deploybot: Ramp to 50% at 1722230046.

hari: monitoring ok, p95 +0.7% p99 +1.0%, error_rate 0.1%. infra standing by.

oncall-zoe: 50% steady for 3m, go to 100% when ready.

deploybot: Rollout to 100% completed at 1722230060.

carmen: rollout finished with no rollback. publishing RN-512 and tagging post-release tasks. thanks everyone for quick approval and standby. :rocket:

releasebot: RN-512 published. ledger entry L-10100 created and marked expedited.

hari: filing a short blameless note to capture root-cause and follow-ups (routing reconciliation check + longer-term guardrails).
